'''Farbinda III''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Farbinda system/Legends|Farbinda system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was the site of a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of conscientious objectors. At one point, an Imperial strike team rounded up the colonists. Witnessed by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tarn Mison]], who had taken a job running supplies to the colony and had also arrived there at the [[Time/Legends|time]], the colonists were all [[Death/Legends|executed]] despite offering no resistance. After subsequently struggling for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] with what he had experienced, Mison went on to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="EGTW" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Tarn Mison}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Farbinda III was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Farbinda [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Farbinda III, in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
